description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a compassplot graphics object.

tr.td: controls whether the object contributes to automatic axes limits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates line rendering alignment on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates annotation metadata used by graphics tools.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle.
reports whether deletion is in progress.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls callback queuing while another callback runs.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
lists child graphics primitives owned by the object.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector.
controls clipping to the parent axes.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the vector line color.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
selects automatic or manual color selection.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates the data tip content shown by interactive data tips.
Type: data tip template object or empty value. Supported values: a data tip template object or an empty value.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
stores the label used by legends and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
controls handle discovery through graphics queries.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls interruption of running callbacks.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the join style used for connected line segments.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'miter', 'round', 'chamfer'.
sets the vector line style.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: '-', '--', ':', '-.', 'none'.
selects automatic or manual line style selection.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets vector line width.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: value greater than or equal to 0.
sets the marker symbol.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: marker symbols such as 'none', 'o', '+', '*', '.', 'x', and other marker names.
sets marker edge color.
Type: color value or marker color keyword. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, 'auto', 'none', or 'flat'.
sets marker fill color.
Type: color value or marker color keyword. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, 'auto', 'none', or 'flat'.
selects data points that show markers.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: positive integer indices or empty value.
selects automatic or manual marker selection.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets marker size.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar values.
stores the parent polar axes.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: polaraxes handle.
controls which visible parts can be picked.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
stores polar radius data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: finite real values with one element per vector.
selects automatic or manual radius data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the workspace variable name used to refresh radius data.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a workspace variable name.
stores the table variable used for radius data.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a source-table variable name.
controls selection state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls selection highlight display.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores the color order series index.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: finite integer values.
stores the table used to create the chart.
Type: table or empty array. Supported values: [] or a table supplied to compassplot.
stores user-defined text for identifying the object.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
stores polar angle data in radians.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: finite real values with one element per vector.
selects automatic or manual angle data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the workspace variable name used to refresh angle data.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a workspace variable name.
stores the table variable used for angle data.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a source-table variable name.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'compassplot'.
stores user data attached to the object.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
controls object visibility.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores internal cartesian x-coordinate data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or numeric data managed by the object.
selects automatic or manual x-coordinate data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or a workspace/table variable name.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or a workspace/table variable name.
stores internal cartesian y-coordinate data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or numeric data managed by the object.

Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.

updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or a workspace/table variable name.
stores internal cartesian z-coordinate data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or numeric data managed by the object.
